user_story:
As a user, I want to click on the 'Click Here' link to open a new window so that I can access additional content without losing my current context. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click on the link with text 'Click Here', a new window should open. 
2. The URL should change to 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/windows/new'. 
3. The original page should remain accessible and visible, specifically the element with id 'content' which contains the text 'Opening a new window Click Here'.
